# Classes of disagreement between the api-json export and GetElementProperties over
# the committed examples, counted per metamodel property (Metaclass::property, the
# export's metaclass) and kind: unresolved-id (the export's id the RPC does not
# resolve), metaclass (the two sides classify the element differently), value (both
# answer, differently), exported-not-answered, answered-not-exported. Each row names the
# side that is correct and the KerML/SysML clause it rests on. Tab-separated:
# class, kind, count, side, clause. TestElementPropertiesAgreeWithTheAPIJSONExport fails
# on a row not here, on a count above the one here, and on a row here the run no longer
# produces; a count that fell is re-recorded with -update-agreement-ratchet.
